card.name: Words just before 'overload' or 'overdose'
card.fires_on: The word right before an expected 'overload' or similar 'over-' term, such as fluid, iron, or circulatory in warning headings. It also fires on the word before 'Ingestion' or 'Intoxication' in acute-poisoning headings.
